text: わしは　なに　してたのじゃ

structure.jp: なに　してたのじゃ

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on; していた is its past, and してた is the shortened spoken form. してた = 'was doing'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end asks for or gives an explanation; じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. なに してたのじゃ = 'what was it I was doing?'.
